Senior residency completed for at least one year after the completion of the MD degree. Desirable to have a strong interest in research, to work with a multidisciplinary team of engineers, medical professionals, AI ML experts. Willingness to travel in India, related to project activities. Strong understanding of image processing software and to learn AI & statistical analysis is preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th August 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree and an MD in Radiodiagnosis and Interventional Radiology from a reputed institution. Additionally, at least one year of senior residency after MD is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 78,000/- plus HRA at 30%.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What are the desirable qualifications for this post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a strong interest in research, experience working with multidisciplinary teams, and proficiency in image processing software, with a willingness to learn AI and statistical analysis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Project Research Scientist (III) Non Medical.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Delhi located?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi is located in New Delhi, Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
